question: Can ordinary published SOFR/TGCR headline history, excluding later revised statistical series, form an attributable delayed funding-basis input with adequate nonconstant development supply? No asset-price or candidate-profit inference is allowed.
known_prior_exposure: Official current reference-rate definitions and revision/publication policy have been read; ordinary headline revisions are same-day while later statistical updates are separate. All closed Challenge aggregate results are known. No 2023-2025 SOFR/TGCR array has yet been acquired for this proposal; no 2026 candidate values open.

source_scope.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Markets Data API
source_scope.unused_fields: Volumes, percentile rates, indicative or quarterly updated statistics and 2026 values are not research inputs. Preserve original API response bytes for attribution, but do not use extra fields.

frozen_measurements: original API schema and ordinary headline provenance
historical publication/revision policy and method-change scope
same-date paired series coverage and missing dates
basis = 100*(SOFR-TGCR), in basis points, with nonconstant-source counts only
strictly prior 20-source-date median; above/below/tie counts for source dates in 2024-2025; no parameter search

feasibility_rules.history_authority: Ordinary headline endpoint must be distinguished from retrospective updated statistics; unresolved provenance rejects source for binding work.
feasibility_rules.matched_headlines: Every acquired development rate date must have both series or an attributable missing-source record. No manual fill.
feasibility_rules.variation: Require both above and below prior-20 median on at least 30 development source dates each, and at least 180 development dates in total off that median. This is a source-supply screen, not proof of achievable fills.
feasibility_rules.prospective_lag: Any later proposal can use a rate no earlier than broker calendar midnight eight calendar days after effectiveDate, with at most 30 calendar days age. Establish that the normal published/revised headline was available before this delayed bound; do not infer intraday broker-to-UTC accuracy from this rule. The lag is fixed before rate values and may not shorten after the count.
feasibility_rules.no_economic_judgment: No prices, source-to-asset returns, hypothetical PnL, trading direction, risk or exit optimization. This unit cannot claim a V8 challenger.

stop: Close this unit after one complete source adjudication, including infeasible/ambiguous. No alternate rate, median, lag, revision variant or adjacent source rescue follows automatically. Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 before any successor.
live: No Live or Optimization file/process/account action. Existing V7R 0/0 and same-task market-gated handoff remain unchanged.
